install_tell: Docker Compose: port 3000:3000, container named openhands-app-${DATE}, mounts /var/run/docker.sock + ~/.openhands + workspace at /opt/workspace_base; image ghcr.io/all-hands-ai/openhands; AGENT_SERVER_IMAGE_TAG defaults to 1.29.0-python
misconfig_patterns: session_api_keys empty (default) = auth entirely skipped in agent-server; check_session_api_key only validates when config.session_api_keys is populated (source: agent_server/dependencies.py)
DefaultUserAuth.get_user_id() always returns None in OSS mode - no identity enforcement, single-tenant no-auth (source: app_server/user_auth/default_user_auth.py)
LocalhostCORSMiddleware: when OH_PERMITTED_CORS_ORIGINS is unset, logs warning 'No CORS origins configured, allowing origin...' and permits ALL origins - CORS protection disabled by default
Docker socket mounted at /var/run/docker.sock by default compose config - host kernel access via container escape
SANDBOX_USER_ID unset by default - sandbox runs as root unless set
MCP endpoint /mcp active by default via Tavily proxy initialization at server startup
WebSocket /sockets/events/{conversation_id} and /sockets/bash-events accept connections without auth when session_api_keys list is empty
InMemoryRateLimiter (2 req/sec threshold) is IP-based and unauthenticated - no auth gate, only throughput throttle
/api/bash/execute_bash_command provides direct shell execution in sandbox; auth depends solely on session_api_keys being configured

passive: Cache-Control: no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate, max-age=0 on all non-/assets routes (CacheControlMiddleware signature)
FastAPI OpenAPI at /openapi.json: title='OpenHands', description='OpenHands: Code Less, Make More'
Retry-After: 1 header on HTTP 429 responses (InMemoryRateLimiter tell)

active_probe.false_positive_check: Cross-verify /openapi.json description field contains string 'Code Less, Make More'; /api/v1/config returns json_field APP_MODE - distinguishes from other FastAPI services. Catch-all SPA may return 200 on arbitrary paths; anchor on /openapi.json title + APP_MODE field conjunctively.

deployment_tells: Container name pattern: openhands-app-${DATE} (date suffix from env)
Config directory /.openhands at filesystem root (dot-prefixed, not under /home)
FastAPI OpenAPI JSON: /openapi.json version string matches pyproject.toml semver
Legacy OpenDevin branding in older deployments (http.title:"OpenDevin" = 4 Shodan hits as of survey)
AGENT_SERVER_IMAGE_TAG default 1.29.0-python visible in compose env
HTTP 429 Retry-After: 1 tells under rapid probing (InMemoryRateLimiter)
OpenHands runs two server layers: app-server (FastAPI, port 3000, /api/v1/*) + agent-server (software-agent-sdk, internal, /api/* no v1 prefix)
pivot_paths: POST /api/v1/conversations - task submission; body includes task string + optional repository; returns conversation_id for subsequent polling
GET /api/v1/conversations/{conversation_id}/file?path=/etc/passwd - read arbitrary files from sandbox workspace; absolute path required; follow_symlinks=False but no root-jail
POST /api/bash/execute_bash_command - direct shell exec in sandbox; returns BashOutput with stdout/stderr; no auth if session_api_keys empty
GET /api/bash/bash_events/search - poll all bash command history: commands executed + outputs
GET /api/v1/conversations/{conversation_id}/git/diff?path=... - CVE-2026-33718 command injection sink (<=1.4.0); shell=True + unsanitized path
GET /api/v1/sandboxes/{sandbox_id}/settings/secrets/{secret_name} - read raw secret value as plaintext (X-Session-API-Key required, but key may be empty/absent in OSS mode)
GET /api/v1/settings - LLM API key presence flags, model config, agent settings
GET /api/v1/config - returns APP_MODE, GITHUB_CLIENT_ID, POSTHOG_CLIENT_KEY, FEATURE_FLAGS - confirms auth-off state
WS /sockets/events/{conversation_id} - stream all agent events: LLM reasoning, shell commands, file reads, browser actions
WS /sockets/bash-events - bidirectional bash command execution over websocket
GET /api/file/home - workspace directory listing including hidden files (include_hidden=true)
GET /openapi.json - full API schema dump for attack surface enumeration
GET /mcp - MCP endpoint; Tavily proxy active by default, potential SSRF via tool invocation
POST /api/conversations/{conversation_id}/fork - deep-copy conversation event history for replay/inspection

vulnerabilities.summary: Command Injection in Git Diff Handler
vulnerabilities.technique: Unsanitized file_path parameter passed via Python .format() to subprocess with shell=True in openhands/runtime/utils/git_handler.py get_git_diff(); crafted path 'test"; id #' chains arbitrary commands; requires authenticated user (PR:L)
vulnerabilities.impact: RCE as root in runtime container, container escape via docker socket, arbitrary file read, reverse shell

auth_evidence: Agent-server (software-agent-sdk): check_session_api_key skips validation when config.session_api_keys is empty - 'Empty list implies the server will be unsecured' (source: agent_server/config.py). App-server: DefaultUserAuth.get_user_id() returns None unconditionally in OSS mode (source: app_server/user_auth/default_user_auth.py). LocalhostCORSMiddleware logs warning and permits all origins when OH_PERMITTED_CORS_ORIGINS unset (source: app_server/middleware.py). Official docs warn not to expose to untrusted users. Shodan population: 215 http.title:"OpenHands" all HTTP 200 zero 401s; 237 http.html:"openhands".  cat-agent-platforms survey 2026-06-19: 59 confirmed unauth instances, 52/59 with provider API key wired.
sensitive_assets: LLM API keys (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) - presence flagged in /api/v1/settings, raw value potentially in secrets store
Git provider tokens (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps, Forgejo PATs) readable via /api/v1/secrets and /api/v1/sandboxes/{id}/settings/secrets/{name}
Full conversation history: agent LLM reasoning chains, shell commands executed, file contents read - via /sockets/events/{id} or events/search
Repository source code at /opt/workspace_base accessible via /api/v1/conversations/{id}/file or /api/file/download
Docker socket /var/run/docker.sock - host kernel access via container escape (mounted by default in compose)
Arbitrary shell command execution via /api/bash/execute_bash_command when agent-server auth unconfigured
Workspace secrets (custom key-value pairs) stored in FileSecretsStore at ~/.openhands
Tavily API key (search integration) visible in server config
